words_to_learn.en: work abroad, seasonal labor away from home

lines.en: Three years, sweetheart, we loved each other,
not a bad word, sweetheart, did we say.

lines.cyr: Сека вечер либе ти ми велеше:
lines.lat: Seka večer libe ti mi veleše:
lines.en: Every evening, sweetheart, you told me:

lines.cyr: - Ќе те земам либе за невеста.
lines.lat: - Ḱe te zemam libe za nevesta.
lines.en: - I will take you, sweetheart, as my bride.

lines.cyr: Пуста да е либе таа печалба
lines.lat: Pusta da e libe taa pečalba
lines.en: Cursed be, sweetheart, that working abroad,
it parted the two of us, sweetheart.

lines.cyr: сите си дојдоа, тебе те нема.
lines.lat: site si dojdoa, tebe te nema.
lines.en: all have come home, you are not here.

lines.cyr: Кажи, кажи либе што ти сторив,
lines.lat: Kaži, kaži libe što ti storiv,
lines.en: Tell me, tell me, sweetheart, what did I do to you,
that you forgot me, young as I am?

lines.cyr: - Не сум те бре либе заборавило,
lines.lat: - Ne sum te bre libe zaboravilo,
lines.en: - I have not forgotten you, hey sweetheart,
the earth has covered my face.
